resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county report table gives 79 feet 6 inches; the 1960 survey note gives an overall height of 90 feet; the 2022 Lakeland PBS story calls it 90 feet tall. No height is recorded in facts because the sources disagree.

The 2016 Bemidji Pioneer article gives open-by-appointment dates plus fair hours; the 2022 Lakeland PBS article gives fair-week hours only. Both are reported as different years and the fair is recorded as the public opening.

notes_for_editor: The brief's record was right on county (Beltrami), relocated status and coordinates (the county report's GPS is 47.5999, -95.1237, matching the brief). The Forestry Education Center sits on the same fairgrounds as the tower, so the at-record us-mn-pinewood-at-forestry-education-center is consistent with this one. The at-record's height_m of 24.4 (80 feet) is close to the county table's 79 feet 6 inches but not to either 90-foot figure. The original Pinewood site has no source describing it today. Mn MFS is reported as printed; the report's abbreviation key was not read. Fact-check 2026-10-10: added exact quotes for the 2016 regular-hours claim and the fundraising claim; story wording on the 2004 move, the 1960 survey note and the 2016 access claim was reworded to avoid copying the sources.
